data.body:
[P2] Roll back the coordinator-owned attempt rather than its copy

`ScenarioContext.attempts` returns a deep copy, so this `pop()` cannot remove the recorded attempt. If saving `SUBMITTED` fails after `record_attempt()` succeeds, Invoke never runs, but the coordinator retains an unidentified launch. That phantom attempt prevents no-work or controls-only retirement and keeps the persistent fence. Restructure the writes so this save failure precedes attempt registration, or provide a coordinator-supported rollback that also reconciles persisted audit state. Test a journal-save failure after successful attempt registration; the existing audit-failure test exercises a different rollback.
